{{Recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 7 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 2 ounces [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
* 2 ounces [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]], soaked in 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] sweet red [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted and cooled slightly
* 7 sheets of [[Cookbook:Matzo|matzah]], crumbled

==Procedure==
# Combine brown sugar, cocoa, soaked raisins, and melted butter.
# Add this mixture to the crumbled matzah and mix well.
# Divide the mixture into two 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform]] or other [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pans]].
# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the batter to create a flat and smooth surface.  
# Refrigerate for several hours.
